translations.en: After Rinsha led me to my room, just in case,
I checked escape routes and finally settled in.
I surveyed the room that would be mine for a while.
The room was bright and clean,
From the second-floor window,
I had a full view of the central plaza.
The cheap inns I stayed at while on the run,
are worlds apart from this room...
Suddenly, memories of those days came back to me.
Decades ago, for certain reasons, in ancient times
I fought a goddess said to have vanished to heaven
Against a goddess of absolute power, miraculously,
I won in a mutual strike and sealed her will,
With my original body fatally wounded,
I survived by taking the goddess's body...
That was... the beginning of everything...
The god I defeated opposed the ruling gods.
Though called a dark god, it was still a god.
Still, the other gods and their followers
feared me as 'God Slayer' and tried to erase me.
Decades on, with a goddess's body, I stopped aging.
I fought and fled much of the world for decades.
I allied with Lewinia's only goddess, unaffiliated.
I allied with the Water Maiden for temporary haven.
In Lewinia, where Water Maiden is state religion,
Other gods and their followers rarely targeted me.
But in this non-Lewinian town, my true identity
if discovered, all townspeople would be my enemies
and I'd be hunted until fleeing back to Lewinia.
The room had a locked chest for luggage and such,
It was clearly a room meant for long stays.
Caught in thought, I suddenly recalled,
and took from my luggage by the bed a sheathed
dagger.
No large ornaments, but smooth female curves and
the tastefully designed dagger, when I held it,
A languid young woman's voice echoed in my head.
(What, have you finally arrived?)
(Yeah.)
I replied to that voice in my mind.
The source of this voice is the dagger I hold,
It's demon Haishera's voice sealed in the dagger.
This one, after I performed the God Slaying,
challenged me to a fight, but
I defeated Haishera and sealed her in that sword.
Since then, Haishera has recognized me as master,
and as a demon sword, she fought battles with me.
